map.$description: Tokens for MapPlaceholder: a drawn stand-in where a screen shows a map, with listing pins (decision 39, amending decision 32). No live map provider in the prototype; map tiles are licensed artwork.

background.$description: PROPOSED: the light grey behind the drawing while it loads, or with no drawing.

border.$description: PROPOSED: a 1px line where the map meets the list, as AcmeCo's map edge.

height-compact.$description: PROPOSED: the map's smallest height (240px), its height as a band above the list below 1024px. Beside a list, SplitView sets its height: the window below the StickyTop (OBSERVED: AcmeCo's map fills the window's height beside the list and stays put).

size.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's map pins are about 24px tall.

border.$description: PROPOSED: a white edge so a pin reads on any part of the drawing.

label-inset.$description: PROPOSED: the "Map placeholder" badge sits 12px from the corner.
